title: Clarify ownership and provenance headers in the EO seed and fixture timing modules
outcome: The two new test modules document ownership, exclusions and provenance in their source headers, following the repository convention.
acceptance: eo_repository_seed.rs identifies its seed/initialization ownership, excludes case-owned writable files and other EO fixture policy, and names its extraction from engram_turn_checks.rs; fixture_timings.rs identifies its diagnostic ownership/exclusions and new-module provenance, with no behavior change or tests pinning comment text.
